tex_content.html:
Theorem
[classification under nonnegative Ricci or curvature operator] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 5.2.3\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems

  • A compact three-manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb {S}^3$, or a quotient of one of the spaces $\mathbb {S}^3$ or $\mathbb {S}^2\times \mathbb {R}^1$ or $\mathbb {R}^3$ by a group of fixed point free isometries in the standard metrics.

  • A compact four-manifold with nonnegative curvature operator is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb {S}^4$ or $\mathbb {CP}^2$ or $\mathbb {S}^2\times \mathbb {S}^2$, or a quotient of one of the spaces $\mathbb {S}^4$ or $\mathbb {CP}^2$ or $\mathbb {S}^3\times \mathbb {R}^1$ or $\mathbb {S}^2\times \mathbb {S}^2$ or $\mathbb {S}^2\times \mathbb {R}^2$ or $\mathbb {R}^4$ by a group of fixed point free isometries in the standard metrics.
